description: Defines the ProxyConfigService class and related components for managing and observing proxy configuration changes within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ProxyConfigService
classes.description: Service for watching and managing proxy configuration changes, with observer support and platform-specific creation.

classes.name: ProxyConfigService::Observer
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications when proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from proxy configuration change notifications.

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent proxy configuration status and details.

methods.name: OnLazyPoll
methods.description: Periodically called to signal activity for polling-based implementations.

methods.name: UsesPolling
methods.description: Indicates whether the implementation uses polling to detect changes.

methods.name: CreateSystemProxyConfigService
methods.description: Factory method to create a platform-specific proxy configuration service.
